thread:
sara (PM): Quick heads-up — infra slips mean we need an emergency scope triage for the v1 milestone. Proposing a controlled cut + short timeline reset. Thoughts? :hourglass:
km (Eng): On it. What's the non-negotiable launch criteria you're using to decide what stays?
sara (PM): Minimal launch criteria: 1) API stable with SLOs (p50/p95 targets met); 2) rollout + safe rollback path; 3) core SDK routes (generate/chat/embed); 4) basic telemetry + cost breakdown. Everything else is secondary.
ash (Eng): Add model pinning + canary path; enterprise customers will block otherwise.
milo (Design): UX note: if we remove multi-turn chat state we lose demo flows. Can we keep minimal chat state and defer export/advanced features?
sara (PM): Proposal: keep multi-turn chat and core SDK. Cut for v1: conversation export, full admin analytics dashboard, advanced reranking infra, built-in prompt library. Move those to v1.1.
km (Eng): Need a concrete cut matrix so SRE/infra know what to pause. Can you share a table?
sara (PM): Matrix (quick):
```
feature,keep/cut,reason,owner
core-api,keep,launch critical,sara
multi-turn-chat,keep,min viable UX,milo
conversation-export,cut,low launch impact,milo
admin-dashboard,cut,too large for this cycle,km
advanced-rerank,cut,perf + infra risk,ash
sdk-telemetry,keep,min required,sara
prompt-library,cut,nice-to-have,milo
canary-rollout,keep,release safety,km
```
ash (Eng): Cutting dashboard + rerank buys ~3 sprint-weeks on infra. That should let us finish canary and pinning work.
aditya (CTO): Fine with moving non-critical analytics out if rollback/canary are solid. Require a clear migration and rollback doc.
km (Eng): Two engineering asks if we move ahead: 1) prioritize canary automation + rollback; 2) expand e2e smoke tests for throughput and latencies.
ash (Eng): Also add a small KV cache warmup step in the deploy path — cold starts push p95 too high.
milo (Design): I can remove export UI and pare down chat microcopy. Will deliver simplified chat UI by next Tue.
sara (PM): Proposed new timeline (high level): freeze feature set today -> 2-week stabilization sprint -> internal pilot -> 1 week customer previews -> GA. Target GA date: 2026-05-15. Feasible?
km (Eng): Feasible with these cuts. I'll reprioritize the sprint board. Will add feature flags so we can flip features back on if capacity permits.
ash (Eng): I'll re-evaluate the rerank infra estimate and pull it from this sprint.
aditya (CTO): Also prepare a short note for sales/account teams explaining this is a temporary scope reset to preserve latency/cost targets.
sara (PM): Action items: @km - update sprint board and formalize tasks (canary, rollback, KV warmup, tests). @ash - drop rerank from sprint and rebaseline. @milo - simplified chat UI deliverable. I'll update the roadmap + write customer-facing note after PM sync.
km (Eng): Adding owners and will tag infra/SRE. Also adding a short checklist for the internal pilot (smoke tests, canary pass criteria, rollback steps).
aditya (CTO): Good. Keep messaging tight.
sara (PM): Any objections to the cuts?
ash (Eng): No objections.
milo (Design): No objections.
km (Eng): No objections.
sara (PM): Ok locking cuts. I'll post updated milestone doc in #product-roadmap in ~30m. :lock:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-infra-bridge v2 -> staging at 1778422000
sara (PM): Thanks team — will follow up with the pilot checklist and updated roadmap link.
